chunk:
deviations:
  - "No HL7 FHIR R4 resource maps cleanly to an EVV visit. FHIR Encounter is the closest analog but lacks GPS verification, Medicaid-specific service codes, and parent/guardian approval workflow. This canonical is derived from California DDS EVV mandate requirements and Sandata CalEVV API submission fields."
  - "Treat as HCBS-vertical extension. When a stable multi-client standard emerges, migrate fields to align with CMS EVV data element requirements (42 CFR Part 431)."

description: >
  Canonical record for Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) visits in Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS).
  Represents a single caregiver service visit: clock-in, clock-out, GPS verification, service code, and submission
  status to the state EVV aggregator. Used by Cherish Care (California DDS respite services).

required:
  - visitId
  - caregiverId
  - consumerId
  - serviceDate
  - clockInDateTime
  - serviceCode
  - submissionStatus

properties:
  visitId:
    type: string
    description: Unique visit identifier — source system primary key (Salesforce Id or DCI Visit ID)
  caregiverId:
    type: string
    description: Caregiver/employee identifier (maps to Employee__c or practitioner external ID)
  caregiverMedicaidProviderId:
    type: string
    description: Caregiver's Medicaid provider ID required by state EVV aggregator (NPI or state-assigned)
  consumerId:
    type: string
    description: Consumer/client identifier (maps to Consumer__c or patient external ID)
  consumerMedicaidBeneficiaryId:
    type: string
    description: Consumer's Medi-Cal/Medicaid beneficiary ID required by state EVV aggregator
  serviceDate:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: Calendar date of the service visit (YYYY-MM-DD)
  clockInDateTime:
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: Timestamp of caregiver clock-in (ISO 8601 with timezone — Pacific time for California)
  clockOutDateTime:
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: Timestamp of caregiver clock-out (null if visit not yet ended)
  clockInGpsLat:
    type: number
    description: GPS latitude at clock-in — required for EVV mandate location verification
  clockInGpsLng:
    type: number
    description: GPS longitude at clock-in
  clockOutGpsLat:
    type: number
    description: GPS latitude at clock-out (some state aggregators require both)
  clockOutGpsLng:
    type: number
    description: GPS longitude at clock-out
